InitKoopaKid.name: Init Koopa Kid
summary: Sets the Koopa Kid number [state] from the high nibble of the initial Y position (0 Morton, 1 Roy, 2 Ludwig, 3 Iggy, 4 Larry, 5 Lemmy, 6 Wendy)
and sets up that boss fight: spawn position for Lemmy/Wendy, Mode 7 room and walk limits for Morton/Roy/Ludwig, Iggy/Larry platform init.

s01CD92.name: Tables: Koopa Kid type, frame rows and flip
summary: [$187B] by kid number (1 Morton/Roy, 0 Ludwig), animation row offset by kid number, frame offsets 0-8.

s01CDA5.name: Table: sprite X-flip bit by direction

s01CDA7.name: Get draw info wrapper
summary: Calls GetDrawInfoBnk1 (OAM index and off-screen flags).

WallKoopaKids.name: Morton, Roy and Ludwig main routine
summary: Builds the graphics index [$1BA2] = kid row + animation frame + X-flip, draws the Mode 7 room, checks contact with Mario and Mario's fireballs,
turns Ludwig towards Mario, then runs the main state [$151C] through MortonPtrs1.
Main states: 0 waiting, 1 dropping in, 2 fighting, 3 hit, 4 defeated, 5 waiting to end the level.
Room variables: [$36]/[$37] = 9-bit rotation angle, [$38]/[$39] = room size/height parameters (probably).

MortonPtrs1.name: Pointer table: wall Koopa Kid main states
summary: Indexed by [$151C].

MortonPtrs2.name: Pointer table: wall Koopa Kid AI by kid number
summary: Morton and Roy use the wall-walking AI at CODE_01D116; Ludwig uses CODE_01CE6B.

Ptrs01CE72.name: Ludwig AI: stand, fire, walk, jump
summary: Sub-state [$1528]: 0 stand and shoot a boss fireball (CODE_01D059), 1 walk towards Mario and start a jump, 2 jump (room rotates in the jump direction).
Also contains the shared recovery code CODE_01CEA8 (timer [$1540] = $FF).

s01CEAE.name: Tables: Ludwig walk and jump values
summary: Max X speed by direction, walk animation frames, jump X speed.

s01CEB6.name: Ludwig sub-states: walk and jump; hit and death states
summary: $01CEB6: sub-state 1, accelerate towards Mario and start a jump when lined up. $01CEFD: sub-state 2, jump with gravity and room rotation.
$01CF7D: main state 3 (hit): stunned, room returns to normal, counts hits; the third hit ends the fight.
$01CFE0: main state 4 (defeated): kid rises while the room spins and collapses, then smoke. $01D043: main state 5: erase the kid and end the level.

s01D059.name: Spawn boss fireball
summary: Finds a free sprite slot and creates sprite $34 (boss fireball) in front of the Koopa Kid, moving away at X speed +/-$20.
Plays sound effect $17. Returns without spawning if no slot is free.

s01D0C0.name: Check landing on room floor
summary: Snaps the sprite to the floor height of the Mode 7 room for the current [$39] and zeroes its Y speed if it has reached it.
Returns: carry set if landed, clear if still in the air (also clear when moving up or Y high is non-zero).

Instr01D0D4.name: Floor lookup stored as data bytes
summary: Bytes B9 D6 D0 are the instruction LDA.W $D0D6,Y (A = floor Y), hidden as data because the code at $01D0CF jumps over them.

s01D0DE.name: Table: floor Y by room parameter
summary: Indexed from $D0D6 + [$39]/2, so the first entry corresponds to [$39] = $10.

s01D116.name: Morton/Roy AI dispatcher
summary: Runs the sub-state [$1528] through MortonPtrs3.

MortonPtrs3.name: Pointer table: Morton/Roy sub-states
summary: 0 walk around the room walls (CODE_01D146), 1 drop on Mario (CODE_01D23F, outside this chunk).

s01D122.name: Table: wall walk X speed
summary: Indexed by min(hit count, 2) * 4 + wall number.

s01D12E.name: Table: wall walk Y speed
summary: Same indexing as the X speed table. The last four bytes ($26,$26,$D8,$D8) look unused.

s01D146.name: Morton/Roy walk around the room
summary: Animates the kid, narrows the walk limits after hits (Roy and Ludwig-style arena), and walks along the four room walls ([$1594] = 0 floor, 1 right, 2 ceiling, 3 left).
At a wall end the kid turns the corner and the room rotates 90 degrees ([$36]/[$37] angle +/-4 per frame). On the ceiling, when Mario is within $10 pixels below,
sub-state [$1528] becomes 1 (drop on Mario).

s01D239.name: Tables: room rotation and wall step by direction
